title: DBS industrialized AI and the published value claim
titleEn: DBS industrialized AI and the published value claim
fidelityNote: Model counts and the SGD 1 billion figure are DBS's own statements, and they moved between the 16 September 2024 newsroom quote and a later DBS page. This record stores both dates. It is not an independent valuation.
executiveSummary: DBS has industrialized machine learning across the bank and published the scale. On 16 September 2024 the DBS newsroom quoted CEO Piyush Gupta: more than 800 AI models across 350 use cases, with measured economic impact expected to exceed SGD 1 billion in 2025. A later DBS page, current as of May 2025, says more than 1,500 models across 370 use cases and the same 2025 value figure. Harvard Business School published a case on the journey, including the bank's PURE ethical framework. The PM pattern is a use-case portfolio with an owner, a value method, and a human in the loop, not a single model.
problemStatement: A bank can accumulate models that nobody owns, with a value story that is a slide rather than a method. Generative use cases then arrive on top of unclear data rights. Staff and customers cannot tell which decisions are assisted and which are automatic.
opportunity: DBS's published approach is a portfolio: hundreds of models, hundreds of use cases, and a stated economic impact. The September 2024 newsroom also says DBS ranked first for AI strategy leadership in the 2023 Global Evident AI Index and tenth overall, the only Asian bank in that top ten. The HBS case describes the PURE framework for ethical use: purposeful, unsurprising, respectful, and explainable. A May 2025 DBS article says the bank keeps a human in the loop and treats generative AI as a copilot.
strategicAlignment: Industrializing AI means a registry, a value method, and a governance forum. A new generative pilot joins that registry. It does not start a second one.
businessValue: The sponsor can see which use cases have an owner and a measurement, and can retire the rest. The SGD 1 billion figure remains DBS's published expectation, cited with the date of the page that stated it.
regulatoryContext: MAS FEAT and AI risk expectations
deploymentModelLabel: Hybrid, with a central model registry
architecturePattern: A registry of models and use cases, a value-capture method, a governance forum using the PURE tests, and a human accountable for customer-facing or risk decisions. Generative tools sit inside that registry as copilots.
planningBandNote: Amounts and durations below are planning bands for a similar program. They are not the publisher's result and not a price quote.
securityCapabilities: Human in the loop on customer and risk decisions
scopeIn: A registry with owner, purpose, and value method for every in-scope model
A PURE review on new use cases
One generative copilot with a named human decision
A citation note when DBS's published counts are used externally
scopeOut: Adopting SGD 1 billion as this bank's target
A second AI governance forum beside the existing one

narrative.heading: What DBS has published
narrative.body:
On 16 September 2024 DBS said Harvard Business School had published a case on the bank's AI strategy, the first HBS AI case on an Asian bank. The newsroom quotes CEO Piyush Gupta: the bank deploys more than 800 AI models across 350 use cases and expects the measured economic impact to exceed SGD 1 billion in 2025. The same note says DBS ranked first for AI strategy leadership in the 2023 Global Evident AI Index, tenth overall, and was the only Asian bank in that top ten.

The HBS case, as described by Harvard Business Impact, covers the industrialization of AI since 2014 and the PURE framework: purposeful, unsurprising, respectful, and explainable use of customer data. A DBS article current as of May 2025 updates the scale to more than 1,500 models across 370 use cases, still associated with SGD 1 billion of economic value by 2025, and says the bank uses a copilot pattern with a human in the loop for risk and customer interaction.

Those sentences are DBS's account of DBS. A different bank can copy the registry, the value method, and the forum. It cannot copy the billion.

narrative.heading: The PM sequence
narrative.body: Fix the fields. Agree the value math. Inventory the models. Put one generative assistant through the same forum. Quote DBS only with the date of the page.
